webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 500: Protects saved notes during Save. Legacy note records without a valid string ID are retained and assigned stable IDs instead of being silently filtered out. A save now verifies that every previously read note ID remains in the proposed list, checks the latest stored list to reject stale/concurrent overwrites, validates unique IDs, and verifies the persisted list after writing. No APK change. Phone Test pending.
